_about: The models check (rule 12). policy.minimum is the weakest model family a helper may run on, in the order of rank (weakest first); "any" means any named model. The policy is yours to set, in one sentence of your own: a change of policy, rank, families or any switch below, made without your latest own message naming the model, is refused. Only the word lists in freeKeys may change freely. requireSetting: the model must be set by the Agent tool's model setting, because a "Model:" line in a prompt is a claim. readOnlyFloor: "exempt" lets a read-only search helper (readOnlyAgents) start on any model or none, as rule 12 sends searching to the smallest model; "hold" holds it to the minimum too. forkWhenLeadUnknown: a fork runs on the lead's model; "refuse" stops it when that model cannot be seen.

policy.words: The strongest model plans and reviews; the smallest model that does the job well does the rest. Say which model did what.
policy.howToChange: Say it in one sentence, for example "helpers must run on Opus at the least"; Claude then changes policy.minimum, policy.words and policy.since to your words and today's date.
